decisions: protocol-freeze: the frozen protocol copy carries only the BRIEF half of `seeds`; the held-out half lives only in sealed/heldout/<field>.json {field, protocol_sha256, rng_seed, seeds_sha256, heldout}. Split seed defaults to sha256('seed-split:'+field+':'+draft sha) so a repeat freeze is byte-identical; --rng-seed overrides for tests. An amend may not change field or the full seed list (seeds-changed) and reuses the stored rng_seed.

protocol-freeze: approval is verified, not trusted: the file's approval.quote must equal (first 500 chars, trimmed) an `owner` ledger line act=approve, subject `protocol:<field>` or `analysis-plan`, written after the last freeze/amend of that name; an amend needs a NEWER owner line. Key errors (R46) exit 1 with slugs key-format/key-prefix/key-duplicate/key-two-owners/key-no-owner/cross-self (contract decision 24), not 3. Layer draft exit codes 3 and 4 are replaced by 1.

protocol-freeze: question_ids of the frozen protocol are the approved list; questions_sha = sha256 of canonical sorted question_ids (returned in result). amend reason codes are a closed list (question-change|criteria|routes|sesoi|vocab|must-read|fixed-files|schema-version|other). Refusals after the ce check append an `incident` line (R58); an interrupted run is completed by re-running (files first, ledger last).

compare: an unfrozen or hash-mismatched plan gives exit 0 with label 'exploratory' (design R39 wins over L4's exit 4); anon requires a frozen plan (key file named by plan sha12). Arms come from the plan's arm_tasks (frozen, so no forking paths). Y_q = a fact sentence cites a confirmed card of the pack tagged q, with applies_to inside the card's conditions (rule written out). McNemar is exact two-sided, conditional on the run; the reading is only above_spread or no_difference_shown (never 'equal' or 'better'); without S2 every difference reads no_difference_shown. Blinding fails above threshold blind_fail_rate 0.8. Scorer rubric: specificity, support, scope, calibration, integers 0-4, plus guess_arm.

compare: R_same shares T's task, so its tokens are the calls after the ledger commit line of the earlier step (ledger-ts boundary, information only). u is computed as fact sentences citing nothing in the pack (zero if commit enforces R18); the checker sample stays a null reading. Parts that cannot be computed are not_run with exit 0; exit 2 only when no plan, no arm commit, or a named scorer transcript is missing; --scorer-transcript must lie under transcripts_root (66 otherwise).

gate: cut keeps sections 1-7 and only the **Scripts** block of section 10; drops preamble and sections 8, 9, 11-15 and every 'Where the classical assumptions fail' paragraph; deletes tokens matching [PNGDK]\d{1,2}(-\d{1,2})? and tidies leftovers. Section list is my reading of R54's 'layout, role table, script lists, rule texts'.

gate: check binds to sha of the current cut and of the committed hazards object, found only through commit records of design-check tasks (stpa/fmea/mapper rows) whose object cut_sha equals the current cut. Defines d_ schemas stpa/fmea/hazards (rows by kind with fixed column sets: component 9, data 10, flow STRIDE 6). Acceptance of a high hazard is only an owner ledger line (act accept, subject hazard:<id>), so the hazards object has no accepted/owner_quote. P1..P21 constant list; fail beats not_run; stale/missing = not_run; the STPA and FMEA tasks need a clean audit line; action lines come from thresholds named *_max/*_min/*_floor with values from views/measures.json values (matches render spec).

cost: compute is a faithful port (same sections [1]-[8], same figures: coordinator k* 17.6, W* 133.2k, etc., asserted by tests), JSON result plus text in result.text/stderr; predict models the pilot's arms T, R_same, R1, R2, S1 (S2 with --s2) under amendment 1 by default (golden total 60,124,800 at g=2.8k) with stand_in flag and an --actual 2x check; from-transcripts writes plan/unit-costs.json with roles P/g/S0/sigma/o, stage and helper units, t_q/k_q by equal split over cards and ids, unattributed share (>10% or missing transcripts gives exit 2 with the file still written, trusted:false).

thresholds.json: 50 params, each {value, unit, source, gate}; all contract section 3.20 names present with the contract defaults; sources are mapping:<id> (D1-02, D3-06, D1-09, D3-05, D1-05, D5-04, D4-01, D4-09, D5-07, D3-01, D2-01, D2-12, D6-05), owner, guess or measured; the design's own rule is cited in `unit`. Added design thresholds: stop_verify_deltas, audit_coord_turn_factor, seeds_per_class_per_call, proof_seed_share, unattributed_share_max, blind_fail_rate, fill_factor, replan_ratio, s2_allowed, crossed_design_allowed, handover_measure. gate=true means a script refuses or stops work when crossed; false = tuning constant or reading.
cost-inputs.json is the existing inputs.json unchanged in content (tags and sources kept) plus schema_version 1.

Briefs: eight neutral briefs, no placeholders beyond the eight of the contract, no model tier, no outcome wording; seeds/plants never mentioned to checker, fresh reviewer, scorer or design-check roles. child.md also covers roles child-reviewing and control (control starts no readers). Design-check briefs end with TURN-END <task> because field is null. The reader returns {cards<=10, skipped[]} with a no-exact-words escape for summary-only pages (G7). README lists every script in one line and the node --test commands; static checks for briefs, thresholds, cost inputs and README are specified as tcb/test/static.test.mjs.
contract_requests: Analysis plan (section 3.18): add `arm_tasks: {<arm>: {pack?: "<task>:<step>", review?: "<task>:<step>"}}` (arms T, S1, S2 with pack and review; R_same, R1, R2 review only). compare.mjs and render.mjs both read it; without it the arm-to-output mapping is chosen after the results. protocol-freeze checks only the arm_budget keys, so the lib builder must put arm_tasks in analysis-plan.schema.json.

Owner ledger lines: fix the `subject` naming that protocol-freeze and gate verify: `protocol:<field>` and `analysis-plan` (act approve), `hazard:<hazard_id>` (act accept). status.mjs owner must write exactly these.

Section 3.20 thresholds: `value` must be allowed to be an array or object (tcb_paths_protected, weights) although the shape says number|string|bool|null; the file's schema (written by lib) must accept it. Also the contract table says weights {out:1} but the tagged pricing record (cost-inputs, tag M) and cost.js use out = 5: thresholds.json and cost-inputs.json carry 5; correct section 3.20. `source` has no value for 'tests only' or 'design rule': guess/owner are used and the design rule is named in `unit`.

New formats to add to section 3 (all written by compare.mjs, defined in spec/compare.mjs.md): views/comparison.json [comparison], views/blind/index.json, sealed/blind/<plan-sha12>.json; the scorer's structured result {scores:[{item, rubric:{specificity,support,scope,calibration}, guess_arm}]}. Also sealed/heldout/<field>.json {schema_version, field, protocol_sha256, rng_seed, seeds_sha256, heldout[]} (protocol-freeze; render already reads key `heldout`).

Design-check schemas: the builder of gate.mjs writes tcb/schemas/{stpa,fmea,hazards}.schema.json exactly as listed in spec/gate.mjs.md (commit.mjs already accepts kinds stpa/fmea/hazards). gate.json cut_sha and hazards_sha must be nullable (null on not_run when absent).

Section 6 and 1.1: two more reads outside the run root, both read-only: gate.mjs cut --design <path> (the design file lives in the harness-engineering repo) and compare.mjs score --scorer-transcript <path> (must lie under transcripts_root).

replace.mjs / commit.mjs input names the briefs assume: in/protocol.json (the frozen copy; its `seeds` is the brief half only), in/questions_sha.txt (one line, sha256 of canonical sorted question_ids), in/cut.md and in/cut_sha.txt (stpa, fmea roles), in/stpa.json, in/fmea.json, in/problems.md (the design's problem table, a file the coordinator names in tasks-plan inputs) and optional in/hazards.json (mapper role), in/pack.json, in/cards/<card id>.json, in/files/<relpath>, in/snapshots/ (fresh reviewer), and in/reader-brief.md (copy of tcb/briefs/reader.md for roles child, child-reviewing; not control); commit intake writes wt/<task>-e<e>/view/committed.json [{id, kind, file}] of every accepted object so a session can cite card and pack ids it cannot hash.
audit.mjs must accept `TURN-END <task>` as the turn-end line of design-check roles (stpa, fmea, mapper) whose field is null; the briefs end with it.

tms/commit/tms consumers: define questions_sha as sha256 of the canonical sorted question_ids of the frozen protocol (protocol-freeze returns it as result.questions_sha). plan/questions/<field>.json has no format in section 3; protocol-freeze treats the protocol's question_ids as the approved list and does not read it.

Ledger: a kind `unit-costs` (writer cost; data sha256, unattributed_share, trusted) so plan/unit-costs.json leaves an audit line (R31); cost.mjs from-transcripts appends none today. fsck should also check plan/frozen/*.json and completeness/cut-*.md bytes against their names (gate and compare treat a mismatch as fail/exploratory, not tamper, because the contract's gate and compare exit sets have no 3 for it).
tcb/agents/{reader,checker}.md are listed in CONTRACT U5c but not assigned to any task of this unit: someone must write them (reader: web tools only; checker: Read only).
open_points: B_tokens and r_tokens are null with gate true: R45 says a null value is a reading, but admission must refuse when the owner has not set them. I left admit to treat null B/r as 'not set, refuse'; admit's spec must say so.

No tests or code were written (as instructed). The briefs, thresholds.json, cost-inputs.json and README exist as final files; the static test file tcb/test/static.test.mjs is specified in spec/briefs.md but not written.

cost from-transcripts leaves hc, qf, w, serial_fraction and rss_mb null: hand-over trigger, failed calls and memory are not visible in transcripts. t_q and k_q use an equal-split attribution rule (and k uses chars/4) because the design's group-start lines (capacity-check) are deferred; this is a stated approximation, not a measurement of per-key spend.

The design-cut section choice (keep 1-7 and the script block of 10) and the id-removal regex are my reading of R54; if the owner wants section 11 or the full section 10 in the cut, the gate spec's step list changes in one place.

compare's within-conditions rule for 'used within its conditions' is re-implemented from the typed fields (no cross-unit import); it must stay equal to commit.mjs's R18(d) flag rule: commit's spec should be checked against it. u (R_same) is structurally near zero because commit rejects uncited facts; the D8-07 checker sample is left as a null reading.

protocol-freeze's default split seed depends on the draft's content, so the coordinator could in principle edit the draft to move seeds between halves; it cannot read sealed/ but it wrote the list. Logged in the ledger; no stronger defence without an owner-supplied seed.
R_same token attribution uses ledger timestamps as a boundary (information only); a PC sleep inside the child's window does not change counts but a mis-ordered clock could.

Briefs rely on the harness imposing a result schema for readers, checkers and scorers (CONTRACT section 7 item 8) and on guard/profile enforcement of 'Read only' and 'no shell'; the briefs state the rules but cannot enforce them. The reader's 'at most 10 cards' is a guess with no threshold entry.
The lock-busy tests (T4) rely on lib's real 2 s retry unless the test seam used by the lib builder shortens it.
